Futuristic Urban Underpass Mural at Night

A night-time view of an urban underpass transformed through immersive mural art. The ceiling is painted to resemble a futuristic or spacecraft-like interior, while the walls depict underwater scenes featuring marine imagery such as a scuba tank and oceanic backgrounds. Streetlights illuminate the wet pavement, bollards line the walkway, and nearby signage—including a “Tabak Trafik” shop sign and a 3.9m clearance marker—anchors the scene in a real city environment. The artwork creates a vivid blend of urban infrastructure and imaginative visual storytelling.
